visual_summary: A small group arrives by a yellow transport on a bleak, cracked or icy-looking surface. Armed escorts in heavy gear surround several robed or cloaked figures and lead them toward a tunnel entrance. Close-up panels show a dark boot stepping across angular stone. The party enters a smooth, blue-lit passage, then appears inside with guards and two stern men in the foreground. In the final wide panel, the group stands together on a faceted platform or ledge within a vast luminous cavern-like space.
